name: openspec-continue-change
description: Use this skill at Step 3 (after openspec-new-change) to expand proposal / design / specs into implementation-ready content. Iteratively fills out the technical approach, data model, contract specs, test strategy, and risk table. Stop when the change is "implementation-ready": every spec has acceptance criteria, design covers all PRD scope items, and the Compliance Design section is fully populated. Chinese trigger examples: "继续 OpenSpec", "OpenSpec 续写", "完善 design.md", "specs 填充". Do NOT use for task decomposition (next step), do NOT use to write code. Success = design.md covers 100% of in-scope PRD items, every spec has acceptance criteria, openspec validate passes.
